citations.basis: Fish collection and individual length recording context.
Identified specimens have individual lengths recorded on fish-collection forms; a later tissue purpose does not erase the original collection.
Catches are sorted by species, counted and weighed, individually or as species groups.
Preserve contributor identity, query/access provenance and WQP DOI10.5066/P9QRKUVJ.

caveats: All24 pairs have source-supported historical occurrence candidates; no pair-level source hold recommended. MAIN approval and validation remain pending.

187 positive rows comprise133 distinct raw hashes and55 activities, not187 unique fish. All have exact binomial, Biological media, Final status, Actual value, valid positive measurement and blank toxicity/unidentified/detection/qualifier/lab/tissue-anatomy fields.

Individual Length/mm and species-specific Total Sample Weight/g describe collected fish; Tissue Count with ng/g,ug/g or percent-by-weight units is chemical concentration and is excluded. Fish-anomaly metrics are excluded from this method.
Selected individual measurements lack BiologicalIndividualIdentifier. Preserve activity/site/date/taxon/raw row identity, and do not infer independent fish counts from repeated identical lengths.
Some NARS trawl descriptions conflict with Backpack Electroshock equipment; other records say Hook and Line or Not Reported. These support field context without establishing exact gear or effort.

Erie OH39043 Result indexes1146 and1154 have activity longitude-82.7758 versus Station-82.8656 at latitude41.4436, about7.5km apart. Both alternatives diagnose in the declared county and exact site identity agrees. Retain a material location discrepancy; neither point is a verified precise collection location.
Lorain indexes1140,1151,1163,1179 and Ottawa1135,1216 have same-county coordinate differences. Selected witnesses use matching coordinates.

Offshore NCCA points for26031,26047,26055,26063,39085,55075 and additional Cuyahoga/StClair rows fall outside cartographic land polygons. The topology does not verify water jurisdiction. Keep explicit publisher county and sampled scope; no point tested landed in a contradictory polygon.

Marinette55075 offshore location is about2.85km from declared Marinette polygon and5.56km from Oconto, with no diagnostic reassignment basis. Generalized topology SHA25671bcbd0571137d470e667da72a4bfd1487e542486a085dbdfded2625fdb5166a is not precise boundary evidence.

No positive witness contained explicit experimental, stocking, hatchery, transplant, captive, toxicity, invalid-sample or dockside-purchase context. Generic manual allowances do not prove a particular sample used them.

Retain exact contributing publishers Indiana STORET, Michigan DEQ, Division of Surface water(Ohio), EPA National Aquatic Resources Survey(NARS), original WQP queries and DOI. No blanket CC0 license established.
WQX2.2 USGS coverage limitation remains. No national completeness, current persistence, establishment, abundance, absence or non-detection claim follows from these rows.
